story_title: Trump says the Iran war is effectively over. What the record shows since the midterms

records.title: Press Conference: Donald Trump Holds an Impromptu News Conference - November 9, 2026
records.quote: And the other is Iran. And Iran militarily is effectively over.
records.about: Factba.se transcript of Trump's unscheduled White House briefing on November 9, after meeting Qatar's prime minister, in which he said the Iran war is militarily effectively over.

records.title: U.S. Forces Disable Cargo Vessel Attempting to Violate Naval Blockade
records.quote: A U.S. military aircraft fired precision munitions at the stern of St. Kitts-flagged M/V Huda
records.about: Central Command release: a U.S. aircraft fired on and disabled the cargo ship M/V Huda in the Gulf of Oman on November 7 to enforce the blockade of Iran.

records.title: CENTCOM Launches Task Force to Disrupt Iranian Ground Transit Routes Supporting Illegal Shipments
records.quote: Strict enforcement at sea continues against all ships entering or departing Iranian ports.

records.quote: The action was limited, the officials said, with no immediate plans to escalate.
records.about: New York Times report, citing unnamed U.S. officials, of a limited U.S. strike on Qeshm Island on November 2.

records.title: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'

records.about: BBC report of the November 9 briefing, including his answer on why he would not declare an end to the war.

records.title: Secret military strikes on Iran raise transparency concerns
